title: Repair & Maintenance of Zanjmer Lighthouse Station
summary: Offline sealed quotation (percentage basis) for plaster repair, painting, teak wood door/window shutters, melamine polishing and CP brass fittings at the lighthouse tower of Zanjmer (Jhanjhmer) Lighthouse, Bhavnagar District, Gujarat.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, P.N. Marg, Jamnagar

sites.name: Zanjmer Lighthouse, Via-Pithalpur, Dist-Bhavnagar-364135
sites.work: Repair and maintenance of lighthouse tower

scope.item: Repair to plaster 12-20 mm in patches up to 2.5 sqm with white cement based polymer modified self curing mortar; rate 869.55, amount 4,686.88
Dismantling doors, windows and clerestory windows (steel or wood) shutter incl. chowkhats, architrave, holdfasts, stacking within 50 m; rate 475.89
Painting with synthetic enamel paint (Asian/Berger), one or more coats on old work; rate 112.17, amount 9,828.23
Finishing walls with acrylic smooth exterior paint (Asian/Berger weather coat), new work, two or more coats @ 1.67 ltr/10 sqm over primer @ 0.90 ltr/10 sqm; rate 208.14, amount 15,089.98
Providing and fixing 2nd class teak wood 35 mm thick panelled/glazed shutters for doors, windows and clerestory windows (butt hinges and screws paid separately); rate 9,635.95, amount 20,717.30
High gloss/matt finish melamine clear polish on wood work (sealer, filler, two coats melamine polish by spray gun); rate 1,763.14, amount 8,533.61
CP brass aldrop 300x16x5 mm (Godrej/Spheero heavy duty) for lighthouse tower main door; rate 417.57
CP brass tower bolt 250x10 mm; rate 572.31, amount 1,716.94
CP brass handle 125 mm; rate 299.44, amount 898.32
CP brass hanging type door floor rubber stopper; rate 157.66, amount 315.32
CP brass butt hinges 125x85x5.5 mm (heavy type); rate 348.17, amount 2,089.02

money.performance_security: 10% of contract value as performance guarantee/security deposit after LOI, released after satisfactory completion
money.notes: Estimate Rs 64,769 including GST. EMD by DD/FDR in favour of The Director of Lighthouses & Lightships, Jamnagar. Bidders quote excess/less percentage on estimate. Rates inclusive of GST and all taxes; TDS-GST, income tax and labour cess deducted. Payment within 30 days of bill; no advance.

period.completion: 30 days from date of issue of work order

eligibility: Valid registration of appropriate class in civil work category with Central/State Govt department/undertaking/autonomous body
Similar works completed in last 7 years in government organizations: three >= 40%, two >= 50% or one >= 80% of estimated cost
specs: Paints: Asian/Berger; CP brass fittings: Godrej/Spheero heavy duty; 2nd class teak wood 35 mm shutters
notes: Scanned NIQ with Annexure-I terms and Annexure-II percentage-basis schedule (pages 3-4 rotated landscape). Station spelt 'Zanjmer'; matched to Jhanjhmer Lighthouse in the station list. Submission 29/09/2025 15:00, opening same day 16:00 at Deep Bhavan, Jamnagar. Listing shows opening 2025-09-30. Bid validity not printed.
